Website terms

Updated 22 October 2026

These terms cover this Lions Barbers information website. Lions Barbers is at 2 Mint Walk, Croydon, CR0 1EA. Contact the shop through the social links below or visit in person.

Services and booking

Service descriptions, photographs, prices and timings help you plan a visit. Images include editorial and AI-created style references; they are not a promise of an identical result. Agree the final look with your professional.

Bookings take place on our separate Barber Dresser platform. A service selection or booking preview is not a confirmed appointment. Check the final service, price, duration, professional and time before confirming. The Lions booking pilot is currently closed pending shop approval.

Payments, changes and cancellations

Any deposit, payment method, cancellation deadline or refund conditions must be shown in the booking journey before you agree. Do not assume online payment is available unless it is offered there. For an existing appointment, use the platform’s available controls or contact the shop. These website terms do not set a cancellation fee or remove your statutory rights.

Using this website

Use the site lawfully. Do not attempt to disrupt it, misuse its content or gain unauthorised access. Photographs, branding and artwork may belong to Lions or their respective creators; do not reuse them without the appropriate permission.

External services

Booking, maps, social media and optional music links take you to separate services with their own terms and privacy information. Availability on those services may change. We update this website when information changes; please check with the shop if you are unsure.
